question: After the PR is rebased cleanly, must the contributor demonstrate this abort race through a live installed plugin binding and routed Telegram or Discord delivery, or should this timing-dependent path receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: Repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external PRs, while the available deterministic tests still mock the affected external route and binding-store boundaries; only an authorized maintainer can accept that limitation as an override.

options.title: Require live routed proof
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway/plugin logs showing a real bound conversation begins routed delivery, is aborted during that operation, emits no stale fallback reply, and still sends the intended stop acknowledgement.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic race test as the strongest feasible evidence for this internal timing window and explicitly override the external real-behavior gate after reviewing the clean rebased head.

recommendation.title: Require live routed proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway/plugin logs showing a real bound conversation begins routed delivery, is aborted during that operation, emits no stale fallback reply, and still sends the intended stop acknowledgement.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and live-validated the plugin-owned conversation-binding behavior whose proof boundary is in question.
